description:
A land surveyor needs a table of all corner coordinates from planning zone polygon boundaries for GPS field verification.

Perform the following steps in QGIS:

1. Load the polygon layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson (contains 2 polygon zones in WGS84/EPSG:4326).
2. Run 'Extract Vertices' (Processing > Vector Geometry > Extract Vertices) on this polygon layer to convert all polygon corner points into a point layer.
3. Run 'Add Geometry Attributes' (Processing > Vector Geometry > Add Geometry Attributes) on the extracted vertices layer to add explicit X (longitude) and Y (latitude) coordinate columns.
4. Export the resulting point layer as a CSV file to: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/polygon_vertices.csv
   Make sure the CSV includes all attribute columns (coordinates, vertex_index, and original polygon attributes like name and id).
5. Save the QGIS project to: /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/vertex_extraction.qgs (or .qgz)

The input polygons have 5 vertices each (4 corners + closing vertex), so expect approximately 8-10 point features in the output.
